name: Receive to Reconciled
description: Work out what each incoming cross-border payment covers and why it is short, fix the cause, then decide whether to keep or convert the money.
note: Highest at every round it entered. Evidence test 21 Oct: 69/100.

name: Payables Timing Agent
description: Legal pay-by date per invoice, pay the undisputed part on time, delay the cheapest payment when cash is short, never a small supplier.
note: Evidence test 21 Oct: 65/100. Buyer-side cost turned out small.

name: Payee Truth Gate
description: Re-check supplier bank details before every payment run; treat every "we changed banks" email as untrusted until called back.
note: Won slot 3 on 17 Oct. Not evidence-tested.

name: Pay-Run Executor
description: Pay contractors across countries for several employer clients, keeping each client's money strictly separate.
note: Airwallex's own Kit 6, already built twice in public, and it needs gated access.

name: Export Proceeds Guardian (India)
description: Track each Indian export invoice against RBI's deadline for bringing the money home, and prepare the bank declarations.
note: Airwallex can't receive Indian export money directly, so it became R2R's India module.

name: Spend Integrity Desk
description: Match every expense receipt to the card record and act on mismatches: hold reimbursements, tighten card limits.
note: Strongest option outside the top three; card issuing access is inconsistent in the sandbox.

name: Merchant Revenue Guard
description: Manage a merchant's chargebacks against Visa's ratio limits, and recover declined card payments without breaking retry rules.
note: Real problem, weaker judge fit; disputes track is crowded.

name: FX Exposure Guard
description: Build a currency exposure list from invoices and orders, and follow the firm's written policy: offset first, convert only gaps.
note: Its core (keep or convert) became R2R's hold-or-convert step; Idle Cash Steward re-scored weakest in its area.

name: Bank-Failure Guard
description: Track where every dollar sits and how protected it is; move payroll money under pre-approved playbooks when a bank looks shaky.
note: Episodic, not a repeated job; other banks must be mocked.

name: Cross-Border Compliance Desk
direction: Around the loop · tax and holds
description: Pick the right withholding tax on foreign payments, and answer bank compliance holds with an evidence pack.
note: Lowest of the nine families.

name: Tax-Ready Cash
description: Set aside tax from each receipt and pay the tax office early, so small firms avoid tax debt.
note: Empty in the hackathon, but consumer "tax pots" exist and the logic is mostly fixed rules.

name: Import Prepayment Release
description: Pay a foreign supplier's deposit and balance only against verified shipping evidence.
note: Open field and real money movement, but no hard evidence of small-firm losses.

name: Statutory Late-Payment Claim Desk
description: The supplier-side mirror of the Payables Timing Agent: claim the late-payment interest you are owed.
note: Interest is worth about £34 per creditor a year; suppliers fear the relationship.

name: Close Copilot
direction: Own idea Â· reconcile with T:0
description: A month-end close agent that pulls Airwallex transactions, matches them to the books in T:0, explains every difference (FX, fees, timing), drafts the journal entries for approval, and acts on what it finds.
note: Rejected later: no money moves, and close agents already exist among entrants.

name: Fair Reserves for Sellers
description: Holds back marketplace sellers' money in stages tied to confirmed deliveries, so honest small sellers get paid sooner and only risky orders stay held.
note: Became the Fair Reserve Desk candidate (23); gated.

name: Restricted Grant Treasurer
description: International NGOs receive grants with strings attached: only for this project, only in this country, only by June. The agent keeps each grant's money separate, pays field partners in local currency, refuses spending that breaks a restriction, and produces donor-ready reports.
note: Wildcard; need never confirmed.

name: Switchyard (rail chooser)
description: For each supplier payment, chooses a local transfer, SWIFT, or on-chain settlement on Metal based on cost, deadline and what the recipient accepts.
note: Earlier suggestion; Metal half probably targeted the wrong chain.

name: Policy-to-Controls Compiler
direction: Own idea Â· Dan Kim's thesis
description: Write a spending policy in plain English; it compiles into real Airwallex card limits and approval rules (one card per agent per task), and proves with tests that the controls match the policy.
note: Crowded among entrants.

name: Renewal Sentinel
description: Reads SaaS contracts and usage, cuts card limits before unused renewals, and drafts the downgrade email.
note: Kit 2 twist; crowded.

name: Late-Failure Watch
description: Keeps watching payments after they show Paid, because they can still fail later, and recovers safely when they do.
note: Kit 3 twist; the most crowded track.

name: Get-Paid-Now Chooser
description: Supplier-side agent that turns wait / early-pay discount (Billing coupon or expiring Payment Link) / factoring / RBF quotes into one annualised cost and cash-by-date view, then finances only the gap and re-decides when tâ€¦
note: Supplier side of financing; financier must be simulated

name: Agent Purchase Recovery Desk
description: Issuer-side recovery: match every card charge (human or agent) to its approved mandate/subscription, and when a vendor or agent charges wrong (renewal after cancel, duplicate, over-mandate) freeze the card and file a deaâ€¦
note: No proof of size; issuing disputes can't be simulated

name: Receivable Passport
description: Builds a revocable, evidence-backed proof that an invoice is real (PO, delivery, buyer acceptance, payer history from Airwallex deposits) before it is financed, avoiding the Greensill 'future receivables' failure mode; oâ€¦
note: Metal-award angle; weak money movement

name: Revenue-Share Lender Desk (Kit 7)
description: Platform agent that collects revenue-share repayments, re-underwrites between tranches from real-time wallet data and borrower signals, and sizes disbursements under a reserve floor.
note: Needs platform access; medium evidence

name: Agent-buyer trust lane
description: For a merchant selling to AI agents (ACP/UCP/AP2): verify the agent's TAP signature, match the order to the approved instruction, accept, re-confirm or refuse, and keep CE 3.0-format evidence for later 'I didn't authorisâ€¦
note: Best Visa fit, but no evidence of size; gated draft API

name: Runway & Forecast Guardian
description: 13-week P50/P90 cash forecast that learns customer lateness from email and history, and when buffer days fall below policy automatically tightens virtual-card limits and reschedules non-critical payouts.
note: Crowded (treasury kit)

name: Sanctions-Hit Pre-Clearance for Payouts
description: Before paying new suppliers or sellers, pre-screen against public sanctions lists and clear false-positive name hits with an OFAC-style, code-enforced disqualification check using KYB documents; strong matches stay held â€¦
note: Airwallex screens already; strong version gated

name: Early-Pay Bridge (contractor earned-wage advance, Kit 6 x 7)
description: When an employer funds late, advance contractors part of their already-earned pay from platform capital under a reserve floor, and recover it from the employer's deposit.
note: Not taken forward

name: Intercompany 24/7 Settlement (Metal leg)
description: SME-sized in-house bank: nets intercompany invoices across group entities, checks arm's-length markup against policy, and chooses the rail (Airwallex local/SWIFT vs Metal tokenized leg for weekend deadlines).
note: Only Metal-award idea; weak evidence, gated

name: Cross-border acceptance cost auditor
description: Computes the all-in cost per country corridor of foreign card sales (international MDR, FX, declines, fraud, disputes) and recommends holding currency, local payment methods or 3DS per corridor.
note: Few levers; overlaps Receive to Reconciled

name: Invoice Twin Catcher
description: Catches near-duplicate and erroneous supplier invoices at intake (re-numbered resubmissions, same lines via another channel) before approval and payment.
note: Already built by an Airwallex prototype and entrants

name: Agent Compute Budget Breaker
description: Per-agent virtual cards fund prepaid API/compute credits; code approves each top-up against budget and burn-rate baseline and freezes a looping or key-leaked agent's card, reallocating budget to healthy agents.
note: Crowded: a direct twin exists

name: Pay-on-Compliant-Invoice Gate
description: Hold supplier payments until a mandate-compliant structured e-invoice (Peppol/ViDA) is received and validated, then release.
note: Shallow decision

name: Mandate-Bound Agent Buyer
description: Give each purchasing agent a verifiable identity and a human-signed mandate; code builds a single-use card exactly from the mandate and verifies TAP signatures, so prompt-injected payees or amounts are declined by the raâ€¦
note: Future-tense losses; crowded

name: Client-Funded Spend Desk
description: Agency or travel cards funded only by that client's receipt.
note: Vendor-only evidence; the self-serve shadow of gated Kit 5.
